## Executive Summary

> {2–4 sentences. Problem → proposed solution → expected benefit → ask.
> This is the only section some sponsors will read. Make it count.
>
> Example: "The current client onboarding process requires 6 manual steps across 3 systems,
> taking an average of 3 days per client and generating a 15% error rate. We propose building
> a unified onboarding portal that reduces this to a single self-serve flow, targeting same-day
> onboarding and <2% errors. Based on 200 new clients/year, this saves approximately 120 hours
> of ops work monthly. We are requesting approval for a 3-month development project at a budget
> of $X."}

## 7. Go / No-Go Criteria

### Go Criteria (all must be true before project starts)

### No-Go Criteria (project should not proceed if any are true)

### Kill Switch (during project)
- {e.g. Actual cost exceeds budget by >20% with no scope reduction path}
- {e.g. Core team loses 2+ members with no replacement timeline}
